messages:
Ana (eng-releases): Quick heads-up — we're planning a phased flip so v2 is the default inference behavior for /generate (no client header) on Thu 03:00 UTC. Goal: make v2 the default while preserving a pin path for clients that need v1.
Devon: timeline OK for infra. what are canary groups?
Ana (eng-releases): Canary groups: 1% internal, 5% beta customers, 25% region stage, then 70% global. 3-hour observation windows between phases.
Priya: Mobile SDK still pins to v1 via Accept-Version header for older SDKs. we need a migration note and a tiny client snippet.
Mike L.: If we expose migration snippet, prefer toggling header name to x-rdw-infer-version for clarity. Some gateways strip Accept-* headers.
Sara: Sounds good. also adding explicit deprecation signal — response header `X-Redwood-Deprecated-V1: true` for any proxied v1 responses during the window so clients can log.
Ana (eng-releases): Good call, Sara. We'll emit the header during the transition window for 60 days. Also adding a rollout flag in /health for automation: `v2_rollout_stage: 25`.
Priya: Release notes draft: short bullets + example curl for migration. Example: ```curl -H "x-rdw-infer-version: v1" https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'```
Devon: Ops checklist: preflight across eu-west1 & us-central1, verify model fallback path, kv-cache warmup. If error rate > 1% or p95 latency regresses > 200ms, auto-pause.
Deploy Bot: deploy scheduled by @Ana at 2026-03-26T03:00:00Z — phases: 1%,5%,25%,70% — safety hold after each phase.
Mike L.: Who owns rollback? If we hit the error trigger, should we pin routing back to v1 or fully rollback the flip?
Ana (eng-releases): Primary plan is traffic pinback to v1 for affected tenants (targeted rollback). Full global rollback is last resort. We'll keep a short-lived 302 shim to route pinned clients to v1.
Sara: Add automated telemetry alert: per-tenant quality regressions (BLEU/embedding cosine) + user-facing token-cost spike. Tie to evalset baseline.
Priya: For release notes: add migration FAQ: "Why did behavior change?" "How do I keep v1?" "How long is v1 available?" Put in SDK upgrade guide.
Devon: Heads-up: policy for clients that pin at infra layer (customer-side proxies) — ops needs a list so we can notify. Who will produce the pinlist?
Ana (eng-releases): Please add entries in the pinlist doc. @Priya will coordinate with support for customers flagged by telemetry.
Priya: I'll export customers with high v1 usage and DM support.
Mike L.: Also need to coordinate with Dedicated customers — some run on our Dedicated infra; confirm training window for their models to avoid cache churn.
Ana (eng-releases): Noted. Dedicated customers will get a private changelog + opt-in date.
Deploy Bot: deploy paused at 1% due to spike in p95 in us-central1. Operator @Devon please investigate.
Devon: Investigating — looks like a kernel selection regression on one shard, routing isolated, increasing qps to fallback nodes. Rolling back 1% to v1 for impacted tenants.
Sara: From product side, flagging notifications for customers that saw pinback: we'll include "temporary pinback due to latency" + link to migration doc. :loudspeaker:
Ana (eng-releases): Thanks team — plan: fix kernel selector, re-run small canary in 2 hours. If stable, continue phased rollout. If not, extend pinback and prepare global rollback playbook.
Mike L.: Logging note: ensure `X-Redwood-Deprecated-V1` header exposure does not leak internal state to customers. Keep value boolean.
Priya: I'll finalize release notes and SDK snippet, post in #general 1 hour before next try.
Ana (eng-releases): Final ask — ops, tag any pinned clients in the tenant DB with `v1_pinned=true` so billing/telemetry can filter.
Devon: Will do. reopening once kernel fix deployed.
Deploy Bot: deploy resumed at 2026-03-26T05:40:00Z — moving to 5% phase after operator sign-off.
